categories.name: ERC 404
categories.content: ERC-404 is an experimental token standard that aims to bridge fungible tokens and NFTs to enable liquidity and fractionalization.

categories.name: Bridged DAI
categories.content: Bridged DAI refers to DAI that has been transferred from its native blockchain to a different blockchain through "bridging'.

categories.name: Bridged Stablecoin
categories.content: Bridged stablecoin refers to a stablecoin that has been transferred, or “bridged,” from one blockchain to another, typically through the use of a blockchain bridge.

categories.name: Camelot Launchpad
categories.content: Camelot Launchpad is a platform for crypto projects to hold Initial DEX Offerings (IDOs). Participants are able to gain early access to public and special token sales on the platform.

categories.name: Emoji-Themed
categories.content: Meme coins related to emoji.

categories.name: Dinari Ecosystem
categories.content: The Dinari Ecosystem comprises tokens tokenized by Dinari.

categories.name: Pools.fun Ecosystem
categories.content: Pools.fun Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via pools.fun

categories.name: Layer 3 (L3)
categories.content: Layer 3 protocols are built on Layer 2, enabling hosting of application-specific decentralized applications while addressing issues such as scalability, interoperability and customization.

categories.name: Capital Launchpad (Kaito)
categories.content: Capital Launchpad is a Web3 crowdfunding platform by Kaito that connects early-stage crypto projects with investors through a merit-based allocation system.

categories.name: Ondo Intelligent Portfolios
categories.content: Single-token portfolio products issued by Ondo Finance that bundle multiple tokenized assets into one on-chain instrument. Each portfolio packages a themed basket that is drawn from Ondo's tokenized equities, ETFs, and in some cases crypto assets.

categories.name: Discord Bots
categories.content: Discord bots are tools that automate tasks to the Discord server, making them more engaging and interactive for users.

categories.name: Healthcare
categories.content: A coin or token that leverages blockchain technology to improve various aspects of the healthcare industry.

categories.name: CreatorBid Ecosystem
categories.content: CreatorBid Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via creator.bid.

categories.name: Bridged-Tokens
categories.content: Bridged-tokens refers to a token that has been transferred or "bridged" from one blockchain to another, typically through the use of a blockchain bridge.

categories.name: NFT Lending/Borrowing
categories.content: Individuals can use their NFTs as collateral to secure loans, or lend out their NFTs to others in exchange for interest, creating liquidity without the need to sell the NFTs themselves.

categories.name: Fractionalized NFT
categories.content: NFT that is being divided into smaller pieces which have more affordable pieces.

categories.name: Uniswap v4 Hooks
categories.content: Tokens of protocols whose core product is built on Uniswap v4 hooks. Hooks turn the AMM from fixed infrastructure into a programmable platform, enabling designs that were impossible in earlier versions: dynamic fees that widen during volatility, MEV-mitigation through batched uniform-clearing-price execution, rehypothecation of idle liquidity into lending markets, vault-managed concentrated liquidity issued as fungible ERC-6909 positions, limit orders implemented as single-tick positions, and lending markets that share collateral with swap liquidity. Projects in this category use hooks as the foundation of their product rather than merely trading on Uniswap.

categories.name: Zora Creator
categories.content: Zora Creator Coins are profile-level tokens on the Zora platform, a blockchain-based social network focused on the creator economy. Each Zora account has its own unique Creator Coin, represented by the user's username as the ticker symbol (e.g., $username).

categories.name: Believe.app Ecosystem
categories.content: Believe.app Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via believe.app.

categories.name: Gaming Marketplace
categories.content: A platform where players can buy, sell, or trade in-game assets, currencies, or digital items.
